messages:
Priya Singh: Heads-up: BlueBridge wants to go live in the marketplace next week. They shipped an adapter for LangChain flows and a Helm chart. Need sandbox signoff + listing runbook.
Ben Ortiz: Quick smoke found two items: (1) quantized model artifacts mismatch (int8 vs int4) causing token framing issues, (2) adapter telemetry missing model_profile tag so Console perf buckets are wrong.
Leah Kim: Logs (trim):
```
2026-04-18T10:12:02Z WARN runtime: model.quantized=llama-13b-qint4 but adapter declares qint8
2026-04-18T10:12:02Z ERROR gateway: token-frame error on sequence id=8423
```
Leah Kim: Short explanation: adapter packaged Q4 kernels but runtime selected Q8 path; kernel ABI mismatch leads to stray token framing on long sequences.
Sam - Integrations: Repro steps I used (local sandbox):
```bash
helm install bluebridge-adapter ./charts/bluebridge --set image.tag=alpha
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.local/v1/gateway/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"adapter":"bluebridge-alpha","flow":"langchain","model":"llama-13b","input":"summarize: product notes","stream":false}'
```
Sam - Integrations: Result = model returns prefix bytes in output occasionally (~1/150 queries).
Nora (Partner PM): Partner says the chart was tested on their side with our runtime in a private test but maybe different quant build. They can re-publish artifacts. They want to keep the joint launch date.
Tess - Marketplace: We need a runnable sample (helm + terraform), SSO instructions, screenshots, short known-issues, perf numbers on H100/A10G, and a single tech contact.
Priya Singh: Proposed checklist for sandbox signoff + listing runbook: 1) Artifact sanity (quantization tag) 2) Telemetry model_profile tag present 3) Helm sample installs into our sandbox without privileged bits 4) Perf snapshot H100/A10G (p50/p95 token) 5) Legal addendum for third-party artifacts 6) Onboarding terraform + support contact.
Lina Legal: For third-party model artifacts we need an explicit indemnity and confirmation of license compatibility (OSS vs commercial weights). I can draft a short addendum to include in the partner form. ETA 2026-04-20.
Ben Ortiz: I can add a small runtime check that rejects adapters whose declared quantization doesn't match the compiled kernel path; it will surface a clearer error. Will do a small PR today.
Leah Kim: I'll add a telemetry shim to inject model_profile if adapter omits it (fall back to adapter manifest). Also add a unit test for token framing regression.
Sam - Integrations: I'll convert their Helm chart into a marketplace sample: minimal values.yaml, note about RBAC and resource requests. Will also add the terraform snippet to register the adapter in our onboarding flow. ETA 2026-04-21.
Nora (Partner PM): I'll ask BlueBridge to rebuild their adapter with qint4 artifacts and to add model_profile in the manifest. I'll get back by EOD 2026-04-19.
ci-bot: CI pipeline #7891 triggered for branch bluebridge-quant-check.
Priya Singh: Dates & owners recap:
- Ben Ortiz: runtime quant-sanity PR and clearer error (2026-04-19)
- Leah Kim: telemetry shim + token-frame unit test (2026-04-20)
- Sam - Integrations: helm->marketplace sample + terraform snippet (2026-04-21)
- Lina Legal: partner addendum draft (2026-04-20)
- Nora (Partner PM): partner to republish qint4 artifacts + manifest change (2026-04-19)
- Tess - Marketplace: draft listing assets checklist & known-issues blurb (2026-04-21)

Priya Singh: If all green we aim to list BlueBridge as "Preview: certified adapter" and publish joint docs the week of 2026-05-04. If the quant mismatch persists we hold listing and issue a technical advisory.
Leah Kim: CI shows a flaky kernel selector test; investigating. Will post update before 12:00 PST.
Nora (Partner PM): Partner acknowledged and will prioritize a republish. Thanks.
Priya Singh: Thanks team — tagging follow-ups @Ben Ortiz @Leah Kim @Sam - Integrations @Lina Legal @Tess - Marketplace.
